title: Fuzzy rule-constrained detection of cognitive offloading in student–LLM dialogues: code and manuscript build
description: Code for the manuscript 'Fuzzy Rule-Constrained Sequential Learning for Detecting Cognitive Offloading in Student–Large Language Model Tutoring Dialogues' (submitted to Applied Soft Computing). Includes weak-label and feature construction for the StudyChat corpus, a five-rule zero-order TSK fuzzy rule base, Łukasiewicz implication constraints for Transformer training, experiments E1–E5 with paired multi-seed tests, and a renderer that builds the manuscript from the statistics file under pre-specified interpretation rules. StudyChat data are not included (access-gated, CC BY 4.0).
